mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO repeated_questions (session_id, question_id, text, type, askers, messages, first_asked_at, last_asked_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{sessionId}, #{q.questionId}, #{q.text}, #{q.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{q.askers}, #{q.messages}, #{q.firstAskedAt}, #{q.lastAskedAt}, #{now}, #{now})
ON CONFLICT (session_id, question_id) DO UPDATE SET text = EXCLUDED.text, type = EXCLUDED.type, askers = EXCLUDED.askers, messages = EXCLUDED.messages, last_asked_at = EXCLUDED.last_asked_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE (repeated_questions.text, repeated_questions.type, repeated_questions.askers, repeated_questions.messages, repeated_questions.last_asked_at) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.text, EXCLUDED.type, EXCLUDED.askers, EXCLUDED.messages, EXCLUDED.last_asked_at)
mapper.select: SELECT question_id, text, type, askers, messages, (reexposed_at IS NOT NULL) AS reasked, first_asked_at, last_asked_at FROM repeated_questions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND dismissed_at IS NULL ORDER BY askers DESC, question_id LIMIT #{limit}
